head: Local Video Upscaler: AI video upscaler app for iPhone and Mac works offline
dek: Local Video Upscaler is a $9.99 app that sharpens old or low-resolution videos to HD or 4K on your iPhone, iPad or Mac, without uploading them anywhere. It was #67 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 15 November.
details: You pick videos from Photos or Files, choose 2x or 4x and a Natural or Clean look, and compare before and after with a slider; the original audio stays in sync and the original file isn't changed. It also smooths grain and compression blocks, works in airplane mode and can queue several videos. The listing says there's no account, subscription, in-app purchase, watermark or length limit. Upscaling is slow: a minute of 480p video takes several minutes on a recent iPhone. It comes from developer David Balderston and has been out since 2 October.
where: iPhone, iPad and Mac, App Store, $9.99 once
means: If you have old family clips or blurry videos someone sent you, this can sharpen them on your own device instead of a website that wants the file.
todo: Try a short clip first, since longer videos take a while, and keep the device charged; save the upscaled copy to Photos or Files.
